Optimize simulated data to match ANOVA F-values

Source: R/fct_optim_aov.R
optim_aov.Rd

Uses simulated annealing to generate raw data that reproduce target ANOVA F-statistics and group means under a specified factorial design.

Usage

optim_aov(
  S,
  levels,
  target_group_means,
  target_f_list,
  integer,
  range,
  formula,
  factor_type,
  subgroup_sizes = NULL,
  thresh = 0.005,
  max_iter = 30000,
  init_temp = 0.001,
  cooling_rate = NULL,
  max_starts = 3,
  progress_mode = "console"
)

Arguments

S

Integer. Total number of subjects.

levels

Integer vector. Number of levels per factor.

target_group_means

Numeric vector of length prod(levels). Target cell means in lexicographic sort order: Factor1 slowest, Factor2 fastest, i.e. 11, 12, 21, 22 for a 2x2.

target_f_list

List with components effect (character) and F_value (numeric) of equal length.

integer

Logical. Generate integer-valued data?

range

Numeric vector of length 2. Bounds for individual observations.

formula

Formula or character. ANOVA model formula.

factor_type

Character vector ("between"/"within") matching length of levels.

subgroup_sizes

Optional numeric vector of between-group sizes (must sum to S).

thresh

Numeric. Convergence threshold. Default 5e-3.

max_iter

Integer. Iterations per restart. Default 3e4.

init_temp

Numeric. Initial SA temperature. Default 1e-3.

cooling_rate

Numeric in (0,1) or NULL (auto). Default NULL.

max_starts

Integer. Number of restarts. Default 3.

progress_mode

Character: "console", "shiny", or "off". Default "console".

Value

An object of class stats2data_aov, a list with components best_objective, data, inputs, adjusted_targets, and track_objective.

Examples

# \donttest{
# 2 x 2 between-subjects design, 10 subjects per cell
res <- optim_aov(
  S                  = 40,
  levels             = c(2, 2),
  target_group_means = c(5.1, 4.2, 6.3, 5.0),
  target_f_list      = list(effect  = c("Factor1", "Factor2", "Factor1:Factor2"),
                            F_value = c(5.0, 6.05, 0.2)),
  integer            = FALSE,
  range              = c(0, 10),
  formula            = "outcome ~ Factor1 * Factor2",
  factor_type        = c("between", "between"),
  progress_mode      = "off"
)
summary(res)
#> Registered S3 method overwritten by 'lme4':
